stages.name: prove stark

root_proof_constant_check.conclusion: root proof is constant across batch size, as documented; the documented VALUE (630,732 B) is stale

stages.name: prove evm
stages.blocker: cargo openvm setup --evm --download stalled: 'minimum throughput was specified at 1 B/s, but throughput of 0 B/s was observed' on kzg_bn254_19.srs after 13m38s and 64 MB of ~2.15 GB
stages.note: infrastructure failure on the vast.ai box, not a scheme result; 130 GB disk free; retry loop in progress

open_questions.q: which change moved the root-proof constant
open_questions.detail: 630,732 B (2026-09-09) -> 534,636 B (2026-09-11). Constant-ness confirmed at S=16 and S=256. Cannot be isolated from here: the old agg keys were overwritten in place by the --evm setup attempts and the 2026-09-09 stark.proof was overwritten by stage 3.

comparable_to.reason: same box, commit, parameters and .vmexe; stage 2 is that record's 256-sig row repeated

not_comparable_to.reason: stage 1 only: different box (vultr3) AND before the preprocessed-commitment removal; the 6.96 s -> 3.74 s gap cannot be attributed to either cause alone
